N1.s: Využili jste všech %lld cutlingů zdarma. Pokračujte v Cutlingu, odemkněte ho a tento cutling se uloží.
N1.back: Used-up you-have all 5 cutlings free. Continue-(you, formal) in Cutling, unlock it and this cutling itself will-save.
N1.why: Opens with S3's exact sentence; the imperative chain names the one path the system prompt offers, and 'tento cutling se uloží' tells the person the item they asked Siri for is not lost.

N2.s: Využili jste všech %lld cutlingů zdarma. Další si uložíte, až Cutling otevřete a odemknete.
N2.back: Used-up you-have all 5 cutlings free. Further-ones yourself you-will-save, when Cutling you-open and you-unlock.
N2.why: Here nothing can continue in the app, so 'až … otevřete a odemknete' says where and when without a command the reply cannot carry out; 'si uložíte' is S4's verb.

N3.why: Keyboard capsule in K1's shape (two segments, middle dot); 'jeden' agrees with the unspoken cutling, and the word reads warmer than a digit; 28 characters.

N4.why: The second segment is S21's impersonal 'Využito … z …', so 5 of 5 says the free ones are filled without a limit word; exactly 30 characters.

N5.why: State first in S29's form, then the two infinitives a tap does, as K1 ends on 'Odemknout'; 'uložit' promises the item in hand is kept; 33 of 40 characters.

N6.why: Same infinitive button verb as S15, sitting where the Share form's save button usually is; 9 characters.

N7.s: Využili jste všech %lld cutlingů zdarma. Odemkněte Cutling a uloží se i tento.
N7.back: Used-up you-have all 5 cutlings free. Unlock-(you, formal) Cutling and will-save itself also this-one.
N7.why: The item is on the form above, so 'i tento' points at it and says it joins the five already kept; 75 characters.

N8.s: Tento cutling na vás počká. Až Cutling otevřete a odemknete, uloží se.
N8.back: This cutling for you will-wait. When Cutling you-open and you-unlock, it-will-save itself.
N8.why: 'počká na vás' is how a Czech speaker says something is put aside for you, and it skips the failure the person does not need to hear; same 'až … otevřete a odemknete' as N2; 70 characters.
